verdict: Distinct work: personal Buddhist study companion tool with RAG-enabled AI, not a reframing of Ora or another known project
best_quote: As a Kadampa Buddhist practitioner, I have text files for every book written by Geshe Kelsang Gyatso. I plan to program an AI agent with a soul.md file drawn directly from his texts and teachings, with all his books scanned, catalogued, and ready for RAG retrieval. I intend to launch a website.
